justification: Text states 'Endast vid de ängar som låg närmare än hundra meter från lampraden ökade fjärilsbesöken påtagligt; längre bort gick ingen förändring att mäta.' D matches: near lamps rose markedly, farther meadows unchanged. A reverses cause; B overstates ('mångdubblade... samtliga'); C is honeybees, unaffected.

Vikbrandt's explanation: 'En stark armatur intill ängen överröstar detta ljusband och får insekterna att cirkla planlöst kring lyktan i stället för att söka sig till blommorna.' A restates this. B/C/D (burning eyes, fear, scent) are not the stated mechanism.

Main message balances value and limits: 'en billig och nästan omärklig förändring ge nattens fjärilar en del av mörkret tillbaka' plus cautions on weather and place ('behöver inte gälla en fruktodling eller en stadspark'). C captures both; B overstates, A and D are sub-points.

Since only meadows within 100 m changed and 'längre bort gick ingen förändring att mäta', the far meadows were little affected by lighting to begin with, so had little to gain. B states this. D is the opposite inference; A (no butterflies at all) is unsupported.

Central objection: 'Det jag vänder mig mot är att vi låter ett enda mått — antalet kroppar som passerar — ersätta frågan om vad kvarteret faktiskt gör med oss.' B matches. A is explicitly denied ('i grunden bra'); C overstates; D is evidence, not the objection.

'Bland dem som uppgav att de återvänt flera gånger tycks kaféerna, inte utställningarna, ha varit det som lockade dem tillbaka.' C = cafés rather than exhibitions. D overstates ('saknade helt betydelse'); B reverses.

'Samma handgrepp — att lägga en blomma mellan sidorna — kan tjäna kunskapen lika väl som saknaden.' A matches. B is contradicted ('desto mindre säker blir jag på att gränsen håller'); C and D overstate.

Selma: 'det systemet som bestämmer ordningen'; Hedda: 'Hennes blommor ligger i den ordning hon fann dem, och under varje står ett datum och ett namn.' D = system vs place/memory. A reverses the two; B/C misstate.
Conclusion: 'what an older learner takes up may matter far less than whether they keep at it... The instrument is optional. The effort is not.' C matches. A/B/D contradict the sober framing.

'modest ones, on the order of a few percent — and... the gains were still there when the same people were tested three months later.' A matches. C is false (under three hours), B overstates ('dramatically'), D unsupported.
'when their attention scores came back, they had climbed by roughly the same margin as the cellists.' D matches exactly. A/B/C all contradict.

'What the two activities had in common was... a fixed weekly commitment, a room full of other people expecting you to show, and the slow... labor of getting better at something genuinely hard.' B matches. A is the discarded music hypothesis; C/D overstated single causes.

'It is an appealing thought, and Fanshawe may well turn out to be right. For now, though, the Merritt data... point somewhere more sober.' Reserved: appealing but evidence points elsewhere = A. B/D too committed, C too dismissive.
'treated them as a passing ___, a fad that would fold' — a passing novelty/fad. C novelty fits; casualty/austerity/loyalty do not.

'their ___ has quietly deepened. Membership schemes now run waiting lists, and publishers court the venues.' Growing appeal = popularity. B. Notoriety is negative; prosperity/familiarity do not fit 'waiting lists'.

'company has proved stubbornly ___ to the download.' Resistant to the download = D. Vulnerable/hostile/superior do not collocate with 'to the download' in this sense of surviving digital substitution.

'a café that misjudges its stock can ___ its slim margins overnight, its shelves clogged with games nobody wants.' Erode its margins = A, the standard collocation for reducing margins. Inflate is opposite; dilute/squander collocate less naturally with 'margins'.

'a certain kind of unhurried, face-to-face pleasure has turned out to be far more ___ than the analysts assumed.' Lasting = durable, B. Portable/disposable/negotiable contradict the theme of enduring appeal.

'the owls begin hunting almost precisely eleven minutes after the local bats leave their roosts... The bats... flush up dense clouds of night-flying moths, and the owls simply harvest.' C matches. D is explicitly denied ('do not chase the bats'); A/B unsupported.

findings.quote: Det skarpa ljuset bränner troligen fjärilarnas känsliga ögon, så att de tillfälligt blir helt blinda och tappar all orientering.
findings.note: CLEAN but eliminable without the passage: it is the only option carrying a hedge plus absolutes ('troligen', 'helt blinda', 'all orientering') and no mechanism in the text supports eye damage, while the passage states the opposite kind of cause verbatim ('Det är alltså inte ljuset i sig som skrämmer dem, menar Selmerlund, utan att det dränker en ledtråd de är byggda för att följa.'). With C also explicitly negated by that same sentence and D ('Blommornas doft försvinner i lampljuset') unsupported anywhere, the item is easier than its position implies.

findings.quote: Studien visar framför allt hur nattfjärilar orienterar sig efter ljuset vid horisonten.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: the orientation mechanism owns a full paragraph and its own glossary entry ('Många nattflygande fjärilar håller kursen genom att luta sig mot det svaga ljusbandet vid horisonten, som forskargruppen kallar himlaranden.'; 'himlarand = det svaga ljuset kvar vid horisonten efter solnedgången'), so a reader can argue it is what the piece dwells on. Beatable: the text frames it as 'Selmerlunds förklaring' of a measured pollination result, not as what the study shows, and the prompt's delimiter ('sammanfattar bäst textens huvudbudskap') is answered by the closing arc that key C tracks clause for clause ('Att släcka eller rikta om enstaka lyktor kostar föga jämfört med de flesta andra åtgärder' + 'det som gäller slåtterängarna i Skaraborg behöver inte gälla en fruktodling eller en stadspark'). Not a defensible second answer; key support is strictly stronger.

findings.quote: De hade så få nattfjärilar att en släckning inte kunde ge något mätbart utslag där.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: it offers a rival explanation of the same null result the key explains ('längre bort gick ingen förändring att mäta'), and low counts are a generic reason a difference cannot be measured. Beatable, and it rests on outside reasoning rather than the text: the passage reports a rich fauna on these meadows ('hade hennes grupp fångat mer än sextio arter av nattfjärilar på just dessa ängar') and a matched design ('Ängarna parades ihop två och två efter storlek och blomrikedom'), which removes any citation for 'så få nattfjärilar', while the stated mechanism ('En stark armatur intill ängen överröstar detta ljusband') grounds key B's hedged 'sannolikt inte nämnvärt'. Not a defensible second answer.

findings.quote: Enbart kaféerna; utställningarna saknade helt betydelse för besökarna.
findings.note: ARGUABLE: like the key C, D points to the cafés, and the passage says 'tycks kaféerna, inte utställningarna, ha varit det som lockade dem tillbaka' — a reader could stretch 'inte utställningarna' into 'exhibitions had no importance'. Beatable: key C mirrors the hedge with 'snarare än', while D over-reaches with 'Enbart'/'saknade helt betydelse', which the hedged 'tycks' and the narrow scope (what brought them BACK) do not support. Key still clearly best; surfaced for adjudication as the closest call.

findings.quote: Margins are narrow, and a café that misjudges its stock can erode its slim margins overnight
findings.note: class 4: register/house-style — the noun "margins" is repeated within one sentence ("Margins are narrow ... its slim margins"), an audible echo a serious-magazine editor would strike; rewrite: "Margins are narrow, and a café that misjudges its stock can wipe out its slender takings overnight"

findings.quote: Antalet honungsbin steg kraftigt på de mörklagda ängarna.
findings.note: Surviving odd-topic tell from the previous version: three options talk about nattfjärilar, this one alone about honungsbin. A reader with no ecology sees the topic asymmetry from form and drops it. One elimination only, so not decisive.

findings.quote: Vid ängarna närmast lyktorna ökade de nattaktiva fjärilarnas besök märkbart, medan ängar längre bort inte förändrades.
findings.note: D is the distance-qualified option and it is corroborated across the unit: q:4's 'påverkades sannolikt inte nämnvärt ... redan från början' and q:3's 'beror på platsen' both presuppose exactly D's near/far split. Within this stem alone A (mixed/null seed-set result) and B (more than doubled) stay live, so it is partial, not decided by form.

findings.quote: Lyktans sken överröstar det svaga horisontljus som fjärilarna orienterar sig efter, så att de cirklar kring lampan i stället.
findings.note: Judged fresh. Domain knowledge names A: celestial/horizon-light orientation and the resulting orbiting of lamps is the textbook mechanism. But the distractors are articulable naive hypotheses, not filler — B (dazzle/eye damage), D (scent masked by light) and C (light-avoidance) are misconceptions a test author writes on purpose, and C only falls to the everyday fact that moths approach lamps. World-knowledge answerability, no form leak; the stem does not telegraph a mechanism.

findings.quote: Konstgjord belysning slår sannolikt ut pollineringen nästan överallt och bör därför avvecklas i så gott som hela landskapet.
findings.note: Stacked absolutes plus a policy leap ('nästan överallt', 'i så gott som hela landskapet') — discardable by form in a huvudbudskap item.

findings.quote: Skymningsglim är helt beroende av insekter för att kunna föröka sig.
findings.note: Altitude mismatch: a single-species detail with 'helt' offered as a main message. Two form eliminations, but A ('Studien visar framför allt hur nattfjärilar orienterar sig ...') is a genuine competitor at summary altitude, so A vs C is not settled inside this stem. What tips C is the sibling stems (q:1, q:4) being about the släckning trial and its place-dependence — cross-question, not form.

findings.quote: De hade fler honungsbin som vägde upp för de uteblivna nattfjärilarna.
findings.note: Same odd-topic filler tell as q:1 (honungsbin among moth options), and the repeat across two stems makes it read as a recycled slot rather than a live hypothesis. Eliminable by form.

findings.quote: De bör ha blivit sämre för fjärilarna, eftersom insekterna nu drogs till de mörklagda ängarna närmare lampraden i stället.
findings.note: No longer self-contradictory — the redistribution mechanism is coherent, so the previous lethal is repaired. It is however mutually exclusive with q:1's D ('ängar längre bort inte förändrades'): solving either stem retires this option in the other. Two eliminations leave A (too few moths to measure) vs B (already outside the light's reach) genuinely open on form; B is favoured only by physical reasoning about light attenuation over 100 m, i.e. domain knowledge, not structure.

findings.quote: Att kultursatsningar aldrig går att mäta på ett meningsfullt sätt.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind_pick B. C is an eliminable absolute ('aldrig'), A and D are narrow specifics unlikely to be 'the main objection', leaving the moderate B; better than chance from form, but B vs C turns on the passage.

findings.quote: Förstagångsbesökarnas nyfikenhet på de nya magasinen.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind_pick null. Stem asks about RETURNING visitors, so A (first-timers) is a stem mismatch and D ('saknade helt betydelse') is an eliminable absolute; the real B-vs-C opposition (exhibitions vs cafes) needs the passage.

findings.quote: Ett herbarium säger i själva verket ingenting om växterna, bara om den som samlat dem.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind_pick A. C is an eliminable absolute ('ingenting... bara') and D is a narrow overclaim; the integrative A vs the divergence-claim B is the real crux the passage decides.

findings.quote: Selmas bok rymmer enbart vetenskap, medan Heddas enbart rymmer känslor.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, blind_pick null. C is an eliminable absolute ('enbart... enbart') and B is a non-parallel pairing; A and D form a clean reversal pair whose direction only the passage settles.

findings.quote: Learning the cello is the most effective way to sharpen an aging mind.
findings.note: Superlative overreach ('the most effective way') is eliminable on form alone in a main-idea item; no passage needed.

findings.quote: New research proves the aging brain loses its plasticity far more slowly than assumed.
findings.note: 'proves' is an unhedged absolute — the second form-only elimination. That leaves B vs C at chance, so the item is materially better than 50/50 blind but not decided.

findings.quote: Every participant improved dramatically once the sixteen-week course had ended.
findings.note: Universal quantifier plus intensifier ('Every ... dramatically') — a no-domain reader discards it by form.

findings.quote: Older beginners tend to progress faster on string instruments than younger ones.
findings.note: Scope mismatch with the stem: a generic trend claim, not a report about 'the volunteers who practiced regularly'. Two form eliminations leave A vs C, with A the only hedged report-shaped option (near-leak).

findings.quote: The readers improved considerably more than the musicians on every measure.
findings.note: 'on every measure' — unhedged universal, discardable by form.

findings.quote: The comparison group seemed to combine some instrument practice with their weekly reading.
findings.note: Self-defeating design claim (a comparison group doing the treatment) reads as filler. Also cross-question: q:4's stem presupposes 'the improvements in both groups', which retires A and decides D without the passage.

findings.quote: The particular skills of cello playing, such as timing and finger control.
findings.note: Stem entailment: the prompt asks what caused improvement in BOTH groups, so a cello-only cause is eliminated by the stem, no passage required.

findings.quote: The friendships formed in class, which fully accounted for every participant's gain.
findings.note: 'fully accounted for every' — absolute overreach. Only B and D survive as shared causes, and B mirrors the stem's 'both groups' wording.

findings.quote: Dismissive: the writer treats the claim as obvious wishful nonsense.
findings.note: Extreme attitude label ('obvious wishful nonsense') — form-only elimination in an attitude item.

findings.quote: Convinced: the writer is sure music holds an unmeasured power over memory.
findings.note: Unhedged certainty about something explicitly 'unmeasured' is self-undercutting. B and D also sit on the same side of the claim, which weakens both; A vs D remains open within the question, but q:4's common-cause framing points to A.

findings.quote: Keepers were paid only when ships arrived safely, so keeping the lamps lit served their own interests.
findings.note: World-knowledge lean, not a form leak. The pay-on-safe-arrival principal-agent moral makes D the recognizable 'best pick' to anyone who knows incentive economics, but C (fixed toll = steady income), A (council oversight) and B (regional standards) are all substantive, passage-groundable alternatives. Crucially C and D BOTH build on the payment fact, so the pre-redesign structural leak (a lone payment option among non-payment fillers) is gone; from form alone the four options are parallel and A/B cannot be dropped without the passage. Genuine comprehension question -> WORLD_KNOWLEDGE flag, not kill; no structural leak survives the redesign.
